source.AUTOHint: The status comes from the attendance rules (punches, shift, leave, holidays).
source.MANUALHint: HR set this status by hand (an applied Set status correction); it overrides the rules until changed.

edit.subtitle: Set the check-in and check-out and, if needed, the status. The outcome below is what the attendance rules make of it; the change is saved as corrections and audited.
edit.pickEmployeeHint: Choose an employee and a date to see the day as the rules see it.
edit.locked: This date is in a locked period — unlock it before editing.
edit.futureHint: It is {{now}} now ({{zone}}). A punch can only be recorded once it has happened: use a time up to now, or edit the day again after the shift.
edit.afterRefused: No outcome for these times: fix the highlighted time to see what the rules make of it.
edit.statusHint: Leave on Automatic to let the rules decide; pick a status to override them.
edit.manualInForce: A manual status is in force: {{status}}.
edit.statusWins: {{status}} will override the rules for this day.
edit.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Forgot to punch out — confirmed by the supervisor
edit.nothing: Change the check-in, the check-out or the status first.
edit.removeIn: The recorded check-in ({{time}}) will be removed.
edit.removeOut: The recorded check-out ({{time}}) will be removed.
edit.updatingHint: Saved — the day is being recalculated.
edit.savedHint: {{count}} correction(s) filed; the day is recalculated within seconds.

bulk.title: Set status for the selected days
bulk.subtitle: {{count}} day(s) selected. Each day gets its own correction with this reason.
bulk.hint: Days in a locked period, or outside your scope, are reported back and skipped; the others are saved.
bulk.tooMany: At most {{max}} days at a time — narrow the selection.

calendar.emptyHint: Employees active during the month appear here, one calendar each.

mapping.title: How Flowza Finance attendance statuses appear here
mapping.hint: Finance keeps ten statuses; FlowZa keeps a status plus flags, so a late half day or a late missed punch keeps both facts.

notes.lateCombines: Late is a flag, so it combines with a half day.
notes.halfDayLeave: Half-day leave adds the Half-day leave flag.
notes.reviewed: Unexcused or loss of pay once the day-close review decides.
notes.halfLeave: A half-day leave shows as Half day or Present with the Half-day leave flag.
notes.missedPunch: The status follows the rule set's missed-punch behaviour.

timeline.title: Punch timeline
timeline.noEvents: No punches in this day's window.
timeline.noRaw: No device transactions in this window.
timeline.rawHidden: Device transactions are visible to roles with the raw-data permission.

sync.hint: Recalculate the days shown here from the punches already received.
sync.queued: Punches are being re-read and the days recalculated.
sync.reason: Sync punches from the attendance register
sync.pickBranch: Choose a branch or an employee first — your access covers selected branches only.
sync.future: Nothing to sync yet for a future period.

live.onHint: New punches appear here on their own a few seconds after the device sends them.
live.pollingHint: Live updates are not connected: this page refreshes every 15 seconds.

summary.title: Attendance summary
summary.subtitle: One row per employee for the month: days, hours and overtime from the daily records you can see.
summary.exportQueued: The summary of {{count}} employee(s) is being prepared. Download it from Reports when it is ready.
summary.emptyHint: Employees active during the month appear here once their days are calculated.
summary.footnote: A half day counts as ½ present. Missing punch: days whose check-in or check-out is missing, so their hours are unknown — counted in Missing punch only (not in Present or Days worked) until the punch is corrected; every other day is in exactly one of Present, Absent, Leave, Holidays and Weekly off. Months whose payroll period is finalised show the finalised figures.

notCalculated.banner: {{count}} employee-day(s) of this month have no calculated attendance yet, so they appear in no other column. Recalculate the month to include them.
notCalculated.reason: Monthly summary: calculate the missing days of {{month}}
notCalculated.queued: Recalculation queued: the missing days appear when it finishes.
notCalculated.pickBranch: Pick a branch (or an employee) first: you can recalculate only the branches you manage.

columns.missingHint: A check-in or check-out is missing, so the hours are unknown: not counted in Present or Days worked until the punch is corrected.
columns.notCalculatedHint: Days of employment, up to yesterday, without a calculated record. Recalculate the month to include them.

unmatched.title: Unmatched punches
unmatched.subtitle: Device punches that could not be linked to an employee. Assign the device user id to an employee, or set the punches aside.
unmatched.readOnly: You can review these punches; assigning or ignoring them needs the device sync permission.

reason.device_user_id: Matches the employee's device user id

assignBlocked.CONNECTOR_RESOLVES_BY_EMPLOYEE_NUMBER: Flowza Finance punches are matched by employee number, not by a device mapping: fix the employee number in FlowZa Time or in Flowza Finance, then re-queue these punches.
assignBlocked.SELF_SERVICE_RESOLVES_BY_MEMBERSHIP: Self-service punches are matched to the user's linked employee record: link the user to the employee (Users), then re-queue these punches.

unmatched.assignHint: Device user id {{id}} on {{device}} ({{count}} punch(es)) will be linked to the employee you choose, and the punches processed again.
unmatched.assignedHint: The employee's days are recalculated as the punches are processed.
unmatched.ignoreHint: The {{count}} punch(es) of device user id {{id}} are kept but no longer processed. You can restore them later.
unmatched.ignorePlaceholder: e.g. Test enrolment on the device
unmatched.restoreHint: The {{count}} ignored punch(es) of device user id {{id}} go back to triage.
unmatched.emptyHint: Every device punch is linked to an employee.

print.screenOnly: Printing and saving need the report export permission
print.notAllowed: This statement is a screen view: printing and saving it need the report export permission.
print.title: Monthly attendance statement
print.finalized: Figures of a finalised payroll period.
print.noEmployeeHint: Open the print view from an employee's profile or the attendance summary.
print.notFound: No attendance for this employee and month
print.notFoundHint: The employee may be outside your access, or not yet active in this month.
